build_transformer_model: build a Gemma Transformer model with a TransformerConfig and run a forward pass on token inputs
run_transformer_forward_pass: run the Transformer forward pass with tokens and optional images to get logits and cache output
init_attention_kv_cache: initialize an attention KV cache for the Transformer with a given batch size dtype and cache length
encode_and_merge_vision_embeddings: encode images through the vision encoder and merge soft embeddings with text token embeddings
apply_transformer_blocks_with_attention: apply the transformer blocks sequentially with positional encoding and attention masking to produce hidden states
